title: The Twin Voice Canon
summary: A canon of two voices sounded as a pair on twin tracks until the souls of both master and partner rise to the limit of their rung.

title: Treatise of the Dual-Track Chorus
summary: A treatise on running a whole chorus on two parallel tracks so one carries the work and the other carries the strength.

title: The Hawk-Crowned Harmony
summary: A manual of the high crowning harmony that rises over an allied company like a hawk on a clear sky and lifts every soul beneath it.

title: Twin-Court Resonance
summary: A teaching of the second voice that answers the first in perfect pairing and makes of two cultivators one sovereign sound.

title: The Wind-Sworn Chorus Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn chorus whose members swear on the gale to hold one note and carry each other through any storm.

title: Treatise of the Sworn Refrain
summary: A treatise on the refrain sworn at the start of a campaign and sung again whenever the company falters or a comrade falls.

title: The Bearing Harmony Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of harmony taken by bearing so that every soul in a company knows its place in the chord and holds it.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Voice
summary: A canon of the open voice that hides behind no cover and fills the field with a harmony no hostile tone can break.
